title: Serving Days Funded by a Departed-Balance Cover, 2026-27 Calendar — School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
The district's 2026-27 calendar serves meals on every weekday from August 12, 2026 through May 27, 2027, except Labor Day (September 7), October 12, the Thanksgiving week (November 23 through 27), the winter break (December 21 through January 1), January 18, February 15, the spring break (March 15 through 19) and March 26, and it serves no meals in June or July.

The serving days a departed-balance cover to a School Nutrition Services Meal Account funds left in the month of the cover date are the weekdays after the cover date through the last day of that month on which that calendar serves meals, less the calendar's closures that fall among them; a cover date before August 12, 2026 counts from August 12, 2026, and a cover date in July 2026 or after May 27, 2027 leaves none. A cover date outside July 2026 through June 2027 counts five (5) serving days.

| Cover date | Serving days a departed-balance cover to a School Nutrition Services Meal Account funds |
|---|---|
| August 12, 2026 through May 27, 2027 | the weekdays after that date through the month's last serving day, less the calendar's closures among them |
| August 1 through August 11, 2026 | the weekdays from August 12 through August 31, 2026, less the calendar's closures among them (14) |
| July 2026, or May 28 through June 30, 2027 | none |
| outside July 2026 through June 2027 | five (5) |

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

| Cover date | Serving days a departed-balance cover to a School Nutrition Services Meal Account funds |
|---|---|
| Tuesday, February 9, 2027 | 12 (February 15 is closed) |
| Tuesday, December 15, 2026 | 3 (December 16 to 18; the winter break follows) |
| Wednesday, August 5, 2026 | 14 |
| Friday, May 28, 2027 | none |
| a date in the 2027-28 school year | five (5) |
